text:
Maiya: idea: a 'rapid-gate' validator for model intake that runs in CI and rejects obviously broken artifacts before scheduling deep smoke. goal: super cheap + deterministic checks.
Vikram: high level ok. what's the diff vs the existing prebench? we need to avoid duplicate effort.
Maiya: prebench stays for thorough perf and regression. rapid-gate is intentionally tiny: artifact integrity, tokenizer sanity, sentinel tokens, a couple deterministic forwards at sampled seq lengths, and a compact semantic check on a 10-item goldset.
Oliver: what's sampled? earlier teams used 16/128/1024; want to avoid long runs.
Maiya: default seeds: [16,256,1024]. if declared max_seq > 1024 we add the declared max too. only single forward per seqlen, decode limited to 2 new tokens with top_k=1 to keep latency low.
Sasha: deterministic decoding avoids RNG flakiness. also special-token ids shifting is a big class of failure.
Maiya: yes: sentinel token validator ensures <eos,bos,pad,unk> present and stable ids; fail immediately on missing/invalid mapping. we also checksum the serialized tokenizer artifact and compare to manifest.
Vikram: quant parity is tricky; how do we treat float vs quant differences?
Maiya: compute token_match and embed_cosine across float vs best-available quant. PASS if (token_match >= 0.88 AND embed_cosine >= 0.94) OR embed_cosine >= 0.96. otherwise mark for full smokehouse.
Danielle: CI cost and caching?
Maiya: rapid-gate prefers model-registry cache and skips re-quant when cached. emit cache_hit flag. target cost ~0.05 GPU-min on cache hits. job runs on tiny-gpu or cpu-fallback pool.
ci-bot: validator/rapid-gate queued on tiny-pool for PR #1024 :gear:
Oliver: observability we need: token-level p50/p95 latency per sampled seqlen, small mem estimate, plus an artifact_checksum and quant_cache_key.
Maiya: included in fingerprint output. sample fingerprint output: "rapid_fp:sha256=abcd...,seqlens=[16,256,1024],perf_ms={16:6,256:42,1024:180},token_match:0.92,embed:0.95,cache_hit:true"
Sasha: how to minimize false positives for tokenization drift? some models legitimately change punctuation tokenization.
Maiya: two-stage comparator: token-level diff (edit-distance, token-shift heuristics) then semantic fallback (sentence embeddings over goldset). only fail if both signals bad or tokenization corrupted (e.g., missing eos or truncated tokens).
Vikram: failure workflow?
Maiya: label PR `rapid-gate:fail` + attach fingerprint + short diff. owners must triage. platform exposes a one-click pin to previous stable quant binary for perf blips. also allow `rapid-gate:ignore-ttl` label for temporary known exceptions; TTL auto-expires.
Danielle: I'll wire CI triggers + cache keys. Maiya: will ship a prototype CLI: `rapid-gate run --manifest manifest.json --gold goldset.json --out rapid_fp.json`. pushing a prototype tomorrow, tagging @oliver for seqlen thresholds review.
Oliver: will review later today. :eyes:
